title: Three Years and One Short Staff
subtitle: 友谊关系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）
meta: 主题语境：友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）　|　核心词汇：relationship　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 relationship 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the elder ① built the relationship that no youth in the village would have noted, and he said the building was the whole of the year. The ② relationship, meaning the bond itself and not the staff, ran three years and stayed unnoted in the book; a relationship, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ relationship in that village had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ relationship at the far gate, meaning the hope they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A relationship, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the elder said the noting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the relationship was the whole of the matter, meaning the trust and not the bond. The ⑥ relationship, meaning the trust and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; relationship, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a bond and a trust. He said the trust is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ relationship had become a line in a memoir, and the memoir had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ relationship of the whole thing, the elder wrote in November, was one village and three years of noting; relationship, he said, is either the hope at the far gate or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ relationship I remember is the bond noted in the memoir, which closed in 1983 and is still noted as the quietest in the village. A ⑩ relationship, my mother said in 1985, is the only bond that improves by being noted; every relationship, she said, is a trust that has agreed to look like a bond. She said the trust was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 关系（指村子里每一段旁边的那一段）
B. n. 关系（指那段关系本身，与短短的拐杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：build the relationship 建立这一段关系
D. n. 关系（指留给孩子们守着的那一个）
E. n. 关系之事（抽象总称，指一处村子的关系之事）
F. n. 关系（指回忆录里写到、被记下的那一段）
G. n. 关系、情分（指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 情分（抽象总称，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: built the relationship that no youth in the village would have noted
The relationship, meaning the bond itself and not the staff
the relationship at the far gate
the relationship was the whole of the matter
the relationship had become a line in a memoir
The relationship of the whole thing
A relationship, my mother said in 1985

answers.why: build the relationship 意为“建立这一段关系”，1976 年那位长者把村子里没有一位后生肯记下的一段关系做了一遍。
relationship 意为“关系”，指那段关系本身而不是短短的拐杖，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记下。
relationship 意为“关系”，指村子里每一段旁边的那一段，每一段旁边都有同一根短短的拐杖。
relationship 意为“关系”，指最远那道村口的留给孩子们守着的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
relationship 意为“关系、情分”，指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这段情分就是那件事的全部。
relationship 意为“情分”，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西而不是那段关系，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
relationship 意为“关系”，指回忆录里写到、被记下的那一段，到 1981 年这一段成了回忆录里的一行。
relationship 意为“关系之事”，长者十一月写道，整件事的关系之事是一处村子和三个年头的记下。
relationship 意为“关系”，我记得的是回忆录里记下过的那一段，1983 年想通了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一段。
relationship 为抽象总称，母亲 1985 年说，关系是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的关系。
